info.title: Packetronix Traffic Generator API
info.description: REST API of the Packetronix Traffic Generator appliance. Served under /TGAPI.

post.description: Close the hardware interface to allow firmware reloads.
Re-initialize the hardware interface after firmware reload.

get.description: Retrieve system information and status.
Get configuration for all ports.
Get configuration for a specific port.

put.description: Update configuration for a specific port and apply to hardware.

post.description: Send an ARP request to the Gateway IP on a specific port.
Send an ICMP Ping request to the Gateway IP on a specific port.

get.description: Get all stream configurations.
Get all streams associated with a specific port.

schema.title: Response Get Streams By Port Streams  Port No  Get

put.description: Update a specific stream configuration and apply to hardware.

post.description: Stop traffic generation for a specific stream.
Inject a single error of a specific type into a running stream.

get.description: Get stream statistics for a specific port.
Get stream statistics for all ports simultaneously.

post.description: Retrieve specific stream statistics in a single batch request.

get.description: Get port statistics for all ports simultaneously.
Get port statistics for a specific port.
Get MAC-level Tx/Rx counters for a specific port, as {"tx": [...], "rx": [...]}. Preferred over /stats/ports/{port_no} for reading counters.

post.description: Reset statistics for a specific port.
Reset statistics for a specific stream on a port.

get.description: Get link status for a specific port.

put.description: Set line rate for a specific port. rate_sel: 1=1G, 2=10G, 3=25G, 4=100G, 5=100G+FEC

get.description: Get line rate for a specific port.

post.description: Set the RX BERT pattern for a specific port.
Enable or disable RX BERT on a specific port.

get.description: Get BERT statistics for a specific port.
List saved test setups (newest first), same files the UI's Load Config menu shows.

post.description:
Save a reusable named test setup, in the same format the UI's Save Config
menu item writes, so it also shows up in the UI's Load Config list.

get.description: Retrieve a saved test setup's raw contents (config + services + selected_services).

post.description:
Start a Y.1564 test run in the background. Provide either `config_name`
(a setup already saved via POST /y1564/configs) or an inline `setup`.
Poll GET /y1564/status for progress and GET /y1564/results once it completes.
Gracefully stop the currently running Y.1564 test (same as the UI's Stop Test button).

get.description: Poll this periodically while a test is running for live status/progress/partial results.

The full structured result of the most recently completed test (config,
per-step config_test/perf_test results, active_services, timing, port_statistics) -
the same object the UI's Export PDF Report button reads from.

post.description:
Generate and download the PDF report for the most recently completed test -
identical output to the UI's Export PDF Report button.

get.description:
List previously completed test result files, newest first, same list the
UI's Test Report History dropdown shows.
Retrieve a previously completed test's full result (same shape as GET /y1564/results).
Capture filter of every port, read back from the hardware (null: no rule on that port).

put.description: Apply a filter to a port and return it as read back from the hardware.

delete.description: Remove the port's filter rule. With no rule the port's traffic is not delivered to the capture path.

post.description: Start a capture. Returns immediately with its capture_id; poll GET /captures/{id}.
Ask a running capture to finish early; what was captured so far is kept (state 'cancelled').

get.description:
The Capture tab's analyses as JSON; with none of the flags set, all three are returned.

loss    - per-stream lost packets and burst lengths from the sequence numbers (Loss / Burst Analysis)
length  - per-stream frame size statistics and length counts (Packet Length Analysis)
latency - per-stream latency and jitter statistics in microseconds (first 16 streams per receive port)

mac.title: Mac
mac.description: Destination MAC (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff); must be blank when mac_filter is 'promiscuous'.

errored.title: Errored
errored.description: Forward frames with FCS, IP or UDP checksum errors.

CaptureFilterModel.title: CaptureFilterModel
CaptureFilterModel.description: Defaults are the Capture tab's defaults: accept everything.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional filters to apply before capturing, keyed by receive port number ("1", "2").

restore_filters.title: Restore Filters
restore_filters.description: Put each overridden port's previous filter back when the capture ends.
